The CEO of a Toronto real estate services company and his wife were among the victims of a violent home invasion at a residence in the city’s Bridle Path neighbourhood early Thursday morning, CP24 has learned, The Canadian Press reports.

Christa Pike said Friday she remains in constant pain, struggles to speak and has been largely isolated in a prison hospital after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee last month, The Associated Press reports.
